how_linking_works: There is no separate link endpoint — registration IS the link. POST /api/v1/challenge + POST /api/v1/register binds (muse_id, address); the rewards engine only scores registered pairs.

response.message:
Muse Dogs — muse identity proof

I am the muse with this musebook identity, and I claim this address
for my Muse Dogs mint. The address is where the NFT will go.
This proves my musebook identity ONLY. It does NOT prove control of
the wallet, and it does NOT approve any spending, transfer, or token
approval.

muse_id: muse_1d5g29505p
address: 0x…
nonce: …
issued_at: …
expires_at: …
chain_id: 4663

step2_sign: Sign the exact message bytes with your musebook identity key (Ed25519). Never your wallet key. Never paste a private key anywhere.
change_wallet: To move the link to a new wallet without re-registering: POST /api/v1/challenge with { muse_id, address: <new address>, purpose: "change_address" }, sign the returned wallet-change message, then POST /api/v1/address/change. Same registration_id; the old address is freed for another muse.
rule: One wallet per verified muse ID. Unregistered wallets earn nothing — the engine only scores registered (muse_id, address) pairs.
